title: Quantum-trace averaging in a nonpivotal fusion category
difficulty_reason: The original author sets up two weighted projector contributions to the average. Starting from a Tr₊-dual basis on Hom(X,Y⊗U), the proof transports both basis families through evaluation and coevaluation to Hom(Y*,U⊗X*), proves the precise d₊(Y) normalization by a mixed trace comparison, and identifies the corresponding isotypic projection. Combining this with naturality of β proves a termwise handle-slide identity whose sum is the original averaging relation. This new weighted dual-basis transport does not assume a pivotal structure or follow from the supplied mixed monodromy identity.
